target.title: feat(grok): handle ask_user_question and exit_plan_mode client extensions
target.body:
## Summary

Grok Build's ACP agent invokes **vendor client extension methods** for interactive tools:

- `_x.ai/ask_user_question` — multiple-choice questionnaires
- `_x.ai/exit_plan_mode` — plan approval (approve / request changes / abandon)

acpx previously rejected unknown `extMethod` calls with Method not found, so these tools always failed when running `acpx grok-build` (while Grok's own TUI works because it implements the methods).

This PR implements:

1. Wire parsers + response builders (`src/acp/grok-ask-user.ts`, `src/acp/grok-exit-plan.ts`)
2. `AcpClient.extMethod` handlers with interactive CLI prompts (TTY)
3. Optional host callbacks on `AcpClientOptions` (`onAskUserQuestion`, `onExitPlanMode`) for embedders
4. Unit tests + wire-format notes under `docs/`
5. **Live behavior proof** against real `grok agent stdio` (see below)

Wire formats were reverse-engineered against `grok agent stdio` (live capture).

## Live behavior proof (2026-07-18)

High-confidence live reproduction is attached:

- [`docs/proof-2026-07-18-grok-ext-methods/`](https://github.com/scottzx/1acp/tree/feat/grok-client-ext-methods/docs/proof-2026-07-18-grok-ext-methods) — **PASS**, `failures: []`
- Re-run: `pnpm exec tsx scripts/grok-ext-live-proof.mts` (requires `grok` on PATH)

| Scenario | Status |
| --- | --- |
| ask_user_question accepted | PASS |
| exit_plan_mode approved | PASS |
| exit_plan_mode rejected | PASS |
| exit_plan_mode abandoned | PASS |

Method: spawn real `grok agent stdio` via `AcpClient`, supply host callbacks that return canned outcomes, assert tool_call updates complete without `Method not found` (map-keyed answers + lower_snake outcomes).

## Test plan

- [x] `pnpm exec tsx --test test/grok-ask-user.test.ts test/grok-exit-plan.test.ts`
- [x] oxlint / build on commit hook
- [x] Live: host-callback path for ask_user_question → accepted (transcript attached)
- [x] Live: host-callback path for exit_plan_mode → approved / rejected / abandoned (transcript attached)
- [ ] Optional: interactive TTY prompts via `acpx grok-build` (callbacks short-circuit CLI UX; unit tests cover prompt builders)

## Notes

- Not included: any WebSocket bridge or product UI (downstream/product-specific).
- Host callbacks follow the same embedding pattern as `onPermissionRequest`.

target.title: fix(ui): bound Nostr profile write/read requests
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The `putNostrProfile` and `importNostrProfile` helpers in `ui/src/pages/channels/nostr-profile-ops.ts` issue `fetch` requests to the gateway/relay Nostr profile endpoint **without any timeout or abort signal**. A stalled or unreachable endpoint hangs the channels page indefinitely while it awaits the response.

This mirrors the same class of unbounded-network-operation fixes (e.g. `fix(ci)`, `fix(docker)`, `fix(doctor)` "bound X" PRs): an unterminated request with no `AbortSignal` can block the UI forever.

## Why This Change Was Made

Add an `AbortController` + `setTimeout` watchdog (`NOSTR_PROFILE_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000`) to both fetches, following the existing Control UI convention used by `browser-client.ts`, `custom-theme.ts`, and `agent-select.ts`. The timeout is cleared in `finally` so no timer leaks.

## User Impact

The channels Nostr profile publish/import actions now fail fast instead of hanging when the relay is slow or down.

## Evidence

### Real behavior proof

**Behavior or issue addressed:** Nostr profile publish/import (`putNostrProfile`, `importNostrProfile`) hang the channels page forever when the gateway/relay endpoint never responds, because the fetch has no abort signal.

**Real environment tested:** macOS 15, Node v24.18.0, vitest 4.1.10, local HTTP server (`node:http`) bound to 127.0.0.1:0. **Real wall-clock time** is used (not fake timers) to prove actual timeout behavior.

**Exact commands run:**
```bash
# Fake-timer regression tests (fast CI feedback)
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/pages/channels/nostr-profile-ops.test.ts

# Real-timeout behavior proof (actual wall-clock validation)
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/pages/channels/nostr-profile-ops.real-timeout.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

**Terminal output showing real timeout behavior:**
```

stdout | ui/src/pages/channels/nostr-profile-ops.real-timeout.test.ts > Nostr profile operations with real timeouts > aborts a stalled putNostrProfile after the real 15s bound instead of hanging
[REAL TIMEOUT] putNostrProfile aborted after 15005ms
[REAL TIMEOUT] Error type: AbortError
[REAL TIMEOUT] Error message: This operation was aborted

 ✓ |ui| ui/src/pages/channels/nostr-profile-ops.real-timeout.test.ts > Nostr profile operations with real timeouts > aborts a stalled putNostrProfile after the real 15s bound instead of hanging 15008ms

stdout | ui/src/pages/channels/nostr-profile-ops.real-timeout.test.ts > Nostr profile operations with real timeouts > aborts a stalled importNostrProfile after the real 15s bound instead of hanging
[REAL TIMEOUT] importNostrProfile aborted after 15002ms
[REAL TIMEOUT] Error type: AbortError
[REAL TIMEOUT] Error message: This operation was aborted

stdout | ui/src/pages/channels/nostr-profile-ops.real-timeout.test.ts > Nostr profile operations with real timeouts > resolves a normal putNostrProfile round trip quickly
[NORMAL] putNostrProfile completed in 15ms

stdout | ui/src/pages/channels/nostr-profile-ops.real-timeout.test.ts > Nostr profile operations with real timeouts > resolves a normal importNostrProfile round trip quickly
[NORMAL] importNostrProfile completed in 9ms

 ✓ |ui| ui/src/pages/channels/nostr-profile-ops.real-timeout.test.ts > Nostr profile operations with real timeouts > aborts a stalled importNostrProfile after the real 15s bound instead of hanging 15003ms
 ✓ |ui| ui/src/pages/channels/nostr-profile-ops.real-timeout.test.ts > Nostr profile operations with real timeouts > resolves a normal putNostrProfile round trip quickly 16ms
 ✓ |ui| ui/src/pages/channels/nostr-profile-ops.real-timeout.test.ts > Nostr profile operations with real timeouts > resolves a normal importNostrProfile round trip quickly 10ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  4 passed (4)
   Start at  23:03:33
   Duration  30.48s (transform 14ms, setup 15ms, import 3ms, tests 30.04s, environment 347ms)
```

**Observed result after fix:**
- Stalled `putNostrProfile` aborts after exactly **15,005ms** (within the 15s bound) and raises `AbortError`
- Stalled `importNostrProfile` aborts after exactly **15,002ms** (within the 15s bound) and raises `AbortError`
- Normal `putNostrProfile` requests complete in **15ms** (fast, no timeout)
- Normal `importNostrProfile` requests complete in **9ms** (fast, no timeout)
- All timeout tests pass with real wall-clock time, proving the abort mechanism works correctly
- Error type is correctly `AbortError` with message "This operation was aborted"

**What was tested:**
- Real wall-clock timeout behavior (not fake timers) against a deliberately stalled local HTTP server
- Normal operation round trips complete in milliseconds
- AbortError is correctly raised and can be caught/handled by UI code
- Timeout mechanism works for both publish and import operations
- Both quick-regression tests (fake timers) and real-behavior tests (real timers) pass

**Key difference from prior evidence:** This uses actual wall-clock time to demonstrate the timeout mechanism, providing real runtime behavior proof that the UI will fail fast after 15 seconds instead of hanging indefinitely. The tests prove the error is recoverable (AbortError can be caught and handled).
